items.notes: ACL note says the layer owns mapping, but the excerpt does not state the risk of leaving mappings unowned; supporting only.
Modernization options and ports-and-adapters isolation; no discussion of local read models or strong read consistency.
HTTP safe/idempotent method semantics and retry effects; no guidance on recovering a submitted job's status after a lost acknowledgment.
Directly identifies the xDS management server and EDS endpoint discovery that Envoy needs before cluster member discovery.
Decision rule requires a known total or an explicit release rule/expiry so an unknown-count split records a partial result instead of silent success.
Claim Check mechanics and payload-lifecycle ownership, but no statement of the failure caused by publishing the token before durable payload storage.
States that outbox publication intent is committed with business state and later handled by a relay, which may resend; answers the post-commit publication gap.
Explicitly states a relay may send a message more than once, which directly supports tolerating duplicate publication.
Contrasts refresh with eviction: a stored value can keep being served during async refresh, and refresh eligibility waits for a query; explains the freshness gap.
Describes write-then-invalidate mechanics and a brief post-write stale window, but not the dependency on reliable change signaling.
